text:
alex: Kicking off a staged rollout for model v2.3.1 -> starting at 10% in eu-west. Change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. Ping if you see anything unusual.

deploy-bot: roll_20260321_01 initiated -> 10% traffic (eu-west). Logs: /rollouts/roll_20260321_01

maya: running the relevance + embedding evals against search-100 set now.

sanjay: Observability: p95 latency for embed endpoints on eu-west-edge up ~+120ms at 10% (no error spike). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/intra/d/embeds

alex: can you paste the query pattern or a sample trace? Is KV cache hit-rate changed?

sanjay: KV hit steady, but host cpu on pod-group embed-eu-2 bumped. sample trace: `GET /v1/embeddings -> worker-23` (attached)

maya: Eval results: spearman dropped -0.03 on search-100 (relevance). Not huge but consistent across seeds.

eva: That delta will regress search metrics for customers. Recommend HOLD at 10% and notify partner slack.

release-manager: Proposal: pause rollout, run 30m canary probe and decide. If spearman < -0.02 rollback. Change window note: partners should be notified if we pause >30m.

ops-jen: Vote: :raised_hand: hold. We need more data before moving to 50%.

alex: Agreed. Pause the rollout and pin traffic back for safety if we cross the trigger. Can we run a targeted A/B for heavy query types?

sanjay: I'll spin up targeted A/B with 20% of the canary traffic routing heavy queries to v2.3.1 for 15m and collect p95, kv metrics.

deploy-bot: roll_20260321_01 -> PAUSED at 10% per operator request (alex). Command: `/rollouts pause roll_20260321_01 --region eu-west`

alex: Confirmed PAUSE. maya/eva, can you prepare a short release-note blurb and a rollback incident if we abort? Keep notes minimal.

maya: Drafting: "Paused v2.3.1 eu-west rollout due to embedding quality regression on internal evals (investigating)." Will link the eval gist in the ticket.

sanjay: collecting p95 and example traces now. ETA 12m.

[12m later]

deploy-bot: Decision: ABORT roll_20260321_01 -> initiating rollback to v2.3.0 in eu-west. Actioned by alex. Command executed: `/rollouts abort roll_20260321_01 && /deploy apply --version v2.3.0 --region eu-west`

alex: Rollback started. Reason: embedding quality regression (spearman -0.03) + p95 latency +120ms on eu-west-edge. Will create incident ticket with full repro steps.

release-manager: Notifying partners and updating status page. ETA rollback completion ~5m.

eva: Filing follow-up for perf tuning and model calibration. Suggest we schedule a controlled re-rollout after fixes and more quantization tests.

ops-jen: I'll own post-rollback validation and hotfix plan. Once rollback completes, we run a shallow 5% canary with enhanced tracing and extended eval hooks.

alex: Thanks everyone — good catch. We'll keep the change window open until post-rollback validation completes.
